comment: Variation of shrink_glob-glob-in-sack-in-sack-shrinks-valkyrie: mkobj.c shrink_glob() 1549. A debug gnome Healer stashes a wished glob of gray ooze in a wished sack, drops the sack, level-teleports to Dlvl 2, searches about 100 turns and returns. The glob's timer expired while the level was saved, so on arrival shrink_glob() catches up the lost shrinkage and updates the weight of the floor sack that holds it (1549).
